conclusion.reason: No Deribit public endpoint returns a deep historical per-strike mark IV / IV time series. get_book_summary_by_currency exposes per-strike mark_iv as a current snapshot only (no history). get_tradingview_chart_data / get_last_trades_by_instrument_and_time return option price/trade series with no IV field and are shallow or no_data for illiquid strikes. get_historical_volatility is currency-level / ATM only and shallow (~16d). get_volatility_index_data (DVOL) is 30d ATM constant-maturity IV only (C294 closed). Per-strike term-structure/skew stat-arb cannot be built without a deep historical per-strike mark IV feed; DVOL must not be relabeled as per-strike term-structure/skew.
